meaning:
συν-ανα-βαίνω
[in LXX for עָלָה ;]
to go up with: with dative of person(s), before εἰς, with accusative loc., Mrk.15:41, Act.13:31.†
(AS)

renderings.kjv: of them which came up with

elsewhere.note: who, when he was in Galilee, followed him and served him; and many other women who came up with him to Jerusalem.
and he was seen for many days by those who came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses to the people.
